name: Leaking Spire
description: The renegades' symbol, a swirl of motion beneath a pointed spire.

timeline.summary: The hooded man shows a Leaking Spire symbol to renegade inventors and steals a listener module from an automaton.
timeline.quote: The little metallic listener module obeyed his commands, prying itself out of her device.

timeline.summary: The thopters change colors and form the leaking spire symbol over the Fair.
timeline.quote: As the metal of the thopters heated, their colors changed through yellows to greens to rich purples and blues

pages_say.description: A symbol that renegade sympathizers hide and recognize.
The renegades' symbol, a swirl of motion beneath a pointed spire.
